row.proto: void Game_Network_SetScenario(void *session, uint8_t stat_id, const void *spec)
row.notes: Logs 'setScenario: scenarioStatId: %d, specRaceVehicleStatId: %s' and 'setGameSetupMode: gameSetupModeStatId: %d'. Returns early when session+0x410 already holds stat_id and the 4-byte spec matches (+0x18, valid flag +0x1c; default spec 0x3fff0000). Else stores stat_id at +0x410 and spec at +0x18, finds the scenario row (g_Game_Scenarios entries, stat id byte +0, game setup mode byte +0x18, entrant list +0x20), applies that setup mode's entrants, marks the session dirty (+0x766/+0x768 and the send thunk 0x143227630) and, when session+8 == 1 (host), sends the scenario to clients. setupFromUnranked ends with it (the scenario whose name equals the category value), session = *(*(self+0x10)+0x418). Callers: census steam 0x30913f0.
